subject: Invoice submission: attachment standards, PO matching, and fallback routing
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.in>
To: Sam Patel <sam@greenleaf.health>
Cc: billing@greenleaf.health
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & invoice channel options (portal vs email)

Hi Sam —

Welcome — were excited to get Greenleaf Health set up. Attached are the vendor onboarding form and a lightweight invoice template we use for ingestion (vendor_onboard_form.pdf; invoice_template.csv). A few quick questions to help us finalize your intake: 

- Do you plan to submit invoices via our portal (preferred) or by email? Either is fine but portal submissions are auto-acknowledged and reduce manual review.
- If email, do you prefer a single address (billing@redwood.in) or will you route from multiple accounts?
- Do you have any multi-page invoice PDFs with embedded line items or will you produce a CSV/Excel export?

For email fallback: we recommend including the PO number in the subject and filename (see example below) so our auto-ingest matches reliably.

Filename recommendation: PO12345_INV6789.pdf
Subject token: Invoice: PO-12345 VendorID-GLF

Attachment guidance: PDF or CSV preferred; max 10MB per file. If you need SFTP ingestion, let me know and Ill share details.

Please fill out the attached onboarding form and send a test invoice (small one-line test is great) so we can validate mapping.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboard_form.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: invoice_template.csv (text/csv)]

From: Sam Patel <sam@greenleaf.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.in>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice channel options (portal vs email)

On Tue, 07 Sep 2027 at 09:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.in> wrote:
> Hi Sam —
> 
> Welcome — were excited to get Greenleaf Health set up. Attached are the vendor onboarding form and a lightweight invoice template we use for ingestion (vendor_onboard_form.pdf; invoice_template.csv).

Thanks Vanessa — quick answers below.

- We would prefer email for now (our portal is still onboarding), so please confirm the exact address to send to.
- We can include PO numbers in the filename and subject.
- Our invoices are normally PDFs with line-item tables (multi-page possible). We can export CSVs if thats preferred for line-level matching.

A couple of questions:
1) Do you require separate tax fields (VAT vs Sales Tax) or is a single tax rate column OK?
2) Will you ingest attachments that are scanned images (OCR)? We sometimes receive scans from clinics.

I attached a sample invoice we usually send. Can you confirm mapping for the line items?

Best,
Sam Patel
Finance Manager, Greenleaf Health
[Attachment: sample_invoice.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.in>
To: Sam Patel <sam@greenleaf.health>, Greenleaf Health Billing <billing@greenleaf.health>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice channel options (portal vs email)

Thanks Sam — answers inline and a few required conventions so our auto-ingest doesnt choke: 

- Tax fields: please include a tax_rate column per line if possible (decimal percent). If not available, include a single invoice-level tax_amount and flag the currency.
- Scanned images: well accept scanned PDFs but OCR accuracy is not guaranteed. If you can provide a CSV export for line-level reconciliation, thats ideal.

Required fields for matching (preferred order):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- po_number
- vendor_name
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price
- line_total
- tax_rate OR tax_amount

Email fallback settings: 
- Send-to: billing@redwood.in
- Bcc (optional): ops_invoices@redwood.in (for our team alerts)
- Subject: please use format "Invoice: PO-<PO#> VendorID-<VID>"
- Filename: please include PO and invoice number, e.g., PO12345_INV6789.pdf

Attachment limits: 10MB per file, up to 3 attachments per message. For multi-page invoices include all pages in a single PDF. If you have many line items, attach a CSV as well.

Well turn on an email ingestion fallback for your vendor account; portal remains preferred since it provides a structured form and automatic acknowledgement. Ill schedule a quick 15-min call if you want to run a live test.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_mapping_instructions.txt (text/plain)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.in>, Sam Patel <sam@greenleaf.health>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.in>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding & invoice channel options (portal vs email)

Vanessa — adding a quick ops note for Greenleaf: our auto-match engine prefers the PO in the filename and the first page header. If you can do both it increases match confidence.

Operational recommendations:
- Filename: PO{po}_INV{invoice} (no spaces, underscores allowed)
- First page header: include VendorID or vendor tax ID if possible (helps duplicate detection)
- If submitting by email, please remove embedded comments or signatures that change table structure — those sometimes break CSV parses.

Sam — Ill attach the lightweight mapping template we use internally so you can see the column order. If Greenleaf prefers the portal we can fast-track an invite.

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ingest_column_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sam Patel <sam@greenleaf.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.in>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.in>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice channel options (portal vs email)

Thanks Vanessa and Marissa — this is very helpful. Well: 

- Complete the vendor onboarding form and return it by EOD tomorrow.
- Start with portal submission; if we hit issues well use billing@redwood.in as the fallback with the filename and subject conventions you outlined.
- Attached is a short test invoice (test_invoice.pdf) — please confirm once it ingests on your side and whether any mapping adjustments are needed.

A couple follow-ups:
- Who should we address for urgent mismatches (if an invoice doesnt auto-match to a PO)?
- Is there a specific VAT field name you prefer in the CSV?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sam Patel
Finance Manager, Greenleaf Health
[Attachment: test_invoice.pdf (application/pdf)]
